# Parse the note content to extract song titles and artists
lines = note_content.split('\n')
# Skip the first line (header)
song_lines = lines[1:]  # lines after "# Spotify Playlist Songs"
songs = []
for line in song_lines:
    if line.strip():
        # Split on " by " to get title and artist(s)
        parts = line.split(' by ')
        if len(parts) == 2:
            title = parts[0].strip()
            artists = parts[1].strip()
            songs.append((title, artists))
        else:
            print(f"Could not parse line: {line}")
print(songs)
